title: Uruguayan Urchin Stir Fry
description: A spicy and savory stir fry inspired by Uruguayan cuisine, featuring succulent urchin and a blend of warm spices.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over high heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook for 3-4 minutes, until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the urchin and cook for 2-3 minutes, until it starts to brown.
Add the spiced stir-fry seasoning and turmeric, and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the urchin is cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
Enjoy your delicious Uruguayan Urchin Stir Fry!
